brittas-bay-beach: One of the east coast's finest beaches, with 4 km of golden sand and protected dunes.
wicklow-historic-gaol: An 18th-century prison turned interactive museum on two centuries of dark history.
russborough-house: An 18th-century Palladian mansion with an ornate interior, a maze and views of the Wicklow Mountains.
portmarnock-beach: A long sandy beach north of Dublin, popular for walks, swimming and water sports.
dun-laoghaire-east-pier: A 1.3 km seafront promenade with views of Dublin Bay, ideal for a walk by the sea.
glasnevin-cemetery-museum: A historic cemetery where the great names of Irish independence rest, with a museum and guided tours.
national-botanic-gardens-dublin: The national botanic gardens with Victorian glasshouses, more than 15,000 plant species and free entry.
epic-irish-emigration-museum: An award-winning interactive museum telling the story of the 10 million Irish who emigrated around the world.
national-museum-archaeology: The national museum with treasures of ancient Ireland: Viking artefacts, Bronze Age gold and bog bodies.
inch-beach: A long sandy beach on the Dingle Peninsula, popular for surfing and walks.
dingle-peninsula: A Gaelic-speaking peninsula with wild beaches, Slea Head and the town of Dingle.
ring-of-kerry: A 179 km scenic circular route around the Iveragh Peninsula, with spectacular coastal views.
gap-of-dunloe: A glacial gorge between mountains, explored by horse-drawn carriages and on foot.
torc-waterfall: A 20-metre waterfall surrounded by woodland, on the slopes of Mount Torc.
ross-castle: A 15th-century castle on the shores of Lough Leane, with boat trips.
muckross-house: A Victorian mansion in the heart of the park, with gardens and traditional farms.
killarney-national-park: Ireland's first national park, with lakes, mountains and Ross Castle.
mizen-head: Ireland's most south-westerly point, with a bridge over the gorge, a maritime signal station and Atlantic views.
charles-fort: A 17th-century star fort at the entrance to Kinsale harbour.
kinsale: A picturesque coastal town with colourful streets, award-winning food and a rich maritime history.
jameson-distillery-midleton: A historic distillery where Jameson whiskey is produced, with guided tours and tastings.
fota-wildlife-park: A wildlife park on Fota Island, with animals in open enclosures and a castle.
titanic-experience-cobh: An interactive museum recreating the story of the Titanic and its link with Cobh.
cobh: A historic port town, the Titanic's last port of call and the departure point of millions of emigrants.
blarney-castle: A medieval castle famous for the Blarney Stone, whose kiss grants "the gift of eloquence".
